data.body: Implemented and landed: warm-then-fan-out for the main Pass-1 chunk/agent pool, ported from the container path. Gate: est shared-prefix tokens >= CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS and >= 2 Pass-1 calls -> the first single-turn chunk runs serially to completion (writing the cache prefix), then the remainder fans out to the pool; systemic LLMUnavailableError on the warm aborts; a non-systemic warm failure degrades to direct fan-out of the remainder (ladder drops that chunk's findings exactly as the pre-change baseline); warm/warmed recorded in coverage.batch_plan. New tests/unit/workflow/test_pass1_warmup.py (6 tests): call ordering via a recording runner, small-plan + single-call bypasses, warm-failure fallback, systemic abort, and one-cache-write/N-1-cache-reads via the d52a per-call usage records. Gates: make lint + make typecheck green; tests/unit 5927 passed (the 2 pre-existing test_plan_review_reuse failures were main-side, fixed by 2c38; rebased onto that fix). Landed via Gerrit change 1042 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved), merged as f6062209d: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1042
